chapter.verse: Zeisu in hih thute a gen khit ciangin vantung lam ento a, “Pa aw, ahun a tung zo hi. Tapa in nang hong minthan’sak nadingin, na Tapa hong minthangsak in.
Nang in Ta’ khut sungah na piaksate khempeuh, nuntak tawntungna a piak nadingin mi pawl khempeuh uk nading thu Ta na pia hi.
Amaute in nang Pasian taktak khat bek leh na sawlpa Zeisu Khazih a theihna un nuntak tawntungna ahi hi.
Ka sep dinga nong piak na khempeuh sem zo ka hih man-inah leitungah na min ka thangsak zo hi.
Pa aw, leitung a om ma-in nangma kiangah ka neihsa minthan’na tawh tu-in nangma kiangah kei hong minthangsak in.”
“Leitungah na hong piaksa mite kiangah na min ka lak zo hi. Tuate in nangma neihsa ahi uh a, kei nong pia zo hi. Nangma thu amaute in a zui uh hi.
Tu-in kei na hong piakte khempeuh in nangma’ aa ahi hi cih amaute in a thei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, nong piak thute amaute ka pia a, amaute in a sang uh a; nangma kiang pan kong pai cih thei-in nangmah in na hong sawl hi cih a um takpi uh hi.
Amaute ading thu ka ngen hi. Leitung mite ading thu ka ngen kei hi. Na hong piak mite in nangma mi ahih man-unah amau ading thu ka ngen hi.
Ka neihsate khempeuh nangma’ aa ahi hi. Nangma neihsate khempeuh keima’ aa ahi hi. Amaute hangin minthan’na ka ngah hi.

Tu-a kipanin leitungah ka om kei ding hi. Hih mite in leitungah a om lai ding uh hi. Nangma kiangah kei kong pai ding hi. A siangtho Pa aw, nang leh kei in pumkhat i hih mah bangin, amaute zong pumkhat a suah nadingun kei nong piaksa mite nangma min tawh kipsak in.
Amaute tawh ka omkhawm lai takin nong piaksa mite nangma min tawh ka kipsak zo a; amaute ka kem zo hi. Lai Siangtho a tun’ nadingin, amaute lakah kisiatna’ tapa khat longal kuamah a kisia kei hi.
Tu-in keimah in nangma kiangah kong pai ding hi. Keima lungdamna hih mite sungah a dim nadingin hih thute leitungah ka om lai-in ka gen hi.
Amaute kiangah nangma thu ka pia zo hi. Keimah in leitung tawh ka kipawl loh bangin, amaute zong leitung tawh kipawl lo ahih uh ciangin, leitung mite in amaute a mudah uh hi.
Amaute leitung pan na lakhia in ci-in thu kong ngen kei hi. Gilopa tawh a kipelh nadingun amaute na kep nadingin thu kong ngen hi.
Keimah in leitung tawh ka kipawl loh bangin, amaute zong leitung tawh a kipawl kei uh hi.
Thuman thutak tawh amaute na siangthosakin. Nangma thu in thuman thutak ahi hi.
Nang in leitungah kei nong sawl mah bangin, amaute leitungah ka sawl hi.
Amaute zong thutak tawh a kisian’thosak nadingun, keimah ka kisiangthosak hi.”
“Hih mite ading bekin thu kong ngen kei hi. Amaute’ thuhilhna hangin kei hong um mite adingin zong thu kong ngen hi.
Nang in kei nong sawl cih leitung mite in a up nadingun Pa aw, keima sungah na om a, kei in nangma sungah ka om bangin, amaute zong eimau sungah om-in pumkhat a suah nadingun thu kong ngen hi.

Eite in pumkhat i hih bangin, keimah in amaute sungah ka om a, nang keima sungah na om bangin, amaute pumkhat suak uh a, pumkhat a kicin’ nadingin nang in kei nong sawl a, keimah nong it bangin amaute na it cih leitung mite in a theih nadingun, nong piaksa minthan’na amaute kiangah ka pia zo hi.”
“Pa aw, kei nong piak mite in zong nong piaksa minthan’na a muh nadingun ka omna-ah na omkhawmsak dingin ka deih hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, lei pian’ ma-inah nong it hi.
A siangtho ka Pa aw, leitung mite in nang a hong theih loh uh hangin, kei in kong thei hi. Hih mite in kei nong sawlpa ka hihna a thei uh hi.
Kei nong it bang itna amaute sungah om a, keimah in amaute sungah ka om nadingin, nangma min amaute kiangah ka lak zo a, ka lak lai ding hi,” ci-in thu a ngen hi.
